title: CYVUI Library Changelog
description: Release notes for the CYVUI library used by CYVHub scripts.

entries.title: CYVUI Library has been updated
changes: Dropdown redesigned: new layout, search field, Select All / Deselect All for multi-select, compact labels, accent border while open, and outside-click close.

Settings fixed: theme preset swatches use reliable click handlers; applying a theme updates accent surfaces live; UI transparency affects the main frame and panels; destroying the UI cleans up the notification holder.
Notifications now match the main UI: panel, border, and text colors follow the theme; type color appears only on the accent bar and progress line; the Notifications toggle is respected.
Floating toggle is always available: a rounded square is created on PC and mobile, can be dragged, and toggles the UI without a MobileToggle flag.
Subtab polish: added a chip-style active state.
Single active window guard: CreateWindow destroys the previous window.
Watermark: added a real on-screen watermark showing title, hub, version, FPS, and ping, with a toggle in Settings → General.
Config: built-in Save/Load uses CYVUI_<name>.json when writefile/readfile are available; OnSave/OnLoad hooks remain supported.
Reload purge: loading any CYVUI script destroys prior CYVUI ScreenGuis, including tracked leftovers in CoreGui and PlayerGui.
